title: Leica GS11 GNSS Smart Antenna
summary:
The GS11 is a multi-constellation GNSS smart antenna with visual surveying built in. Its dual cameras, integrated Class 3R green laser and calibration-free tilt compensation give three ways to reach a point: pole it, tilt it, or shoot it from the imagery.

Paired with Leica X-PAD, the cameras become workflows rather than pictures. Visual stakeout overlays navigation guidance on live site imagery, AR visual survey overlays captured data on the live stream, and image groups let the surveyor create points where the pole tip cannot safely go. Leica quotes image points at typically 5 mm + 2 mm/m up to 10 m, and laser points at typically 10 mm + 5 mm/m up to 25 m.

Underneath it is a serious receiver: 1400+ channels, 8 mm + 1 ppm RTK, dual hot-swappable batteries for a 12 hour day, and 4G LTE with UHF for base-to-rover work. Two configurations: the GS11 T for conventional GNSS surveying with tilt compensation, and the GS11 I with imaging and laser.
specs: 1400+ channels, multi-frequency multi-constellation: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, NavIC, SBAS
RTK single baseline: H 8 mm + 1 ppm / V 15 mm + 1 ppm; network RTK H 8 mm + 0.5 ppm / V 15 mm + 0.5 ppm
Tilt-compensated RTK: additional H uncertainty under 2 mm + 0.3 mm/degree down to 30 degrees tilt, calibration-free and magnetically resistant
RTK initialisation typically under 5 s; static with long observations H 3 mm + 0.1 ppm / V 3.5 mm + 0.4 ppm
Dual cameras: front global-shutter 2 MP at 80 x 69 degrees, 25 fps; down rolling-shutter 5 MP at 80 x 69 degrees, 25 fps (GS11 I)
Integrated green Class 3R laser for indirect point measurement (GS11 I)
Image point measurement typically 5 mm + 2 mm/m (2D) up to 10 m; laser point measurement typically 10 mm + 5 mm/m (2D) up to 25 m
Built-in LTE and UHF (GS11 T 410-470 MHz, GS11 I 403-473 MHz), max 1 W output
Two hot-swappable Li-Ion batteries (3.35 Ah / 7.2 V, 24.12 Wh), typical up to 12 h in GNSS rover mode
Internal memory up to 8 GB, RINEX data up to 20 Hz; IP66 / IP67, -10 to +60 degrees C with camera
accessories: Leica CSX8 controller tablet or other Android device
Leica X-PAD field software and Leica X-PAD Fusion office software
Leica TS13 robotic total station for a hybrid GNSS and total station setup: the total station tracks a prism on the antenna
